title: French Crêpe
description: A classic French crêpe recipe made with a simple batter and served with butter and sugar. This versatile dish can be enjoyed for breakfast or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the quick batter and springy water.
Let the batter rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of the batter into the pan and tilt the pan to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
Flip the crêpe and cook for another 30 seconds.
